// Optional committed-geometry context targets for the pinned Orbit build.
// Default menus/selection are unchanged when no target is registered.
package ui

import "math"

const textMenuTargetLimit = 1024
const textMenuBlockLimit = 4096

type textMenuTarget struct {
	scope, row uint64
	token      any
}
type textMenuBlock struct {
	id     uint64
	bounds Rect
	token  any
}
type textMenuFrame struct {
	scope, frame uint64
	visible      Rect
	blocks       []textMenuBlock
}
type textMenuEvent struct {
	scope, frame uint64
	distance     float32
	token        any
}

// RegisterTextMenuTarget associates selectable descendants of this row with an
// immutable application token within scope. Call each build, on the same window
// and pass. Tokens are opaque references: never formatted, logged or interpreted.
// Only current visible committed rows are retained, with bounded target/block
// counts. Overflow fails closed for that frame. Do not mutate token contents.
func (e Element) RegisterTextMenuTarget(scope Element, token any) Element {
	n := e.node()
	if n == nil || token == nil {
		return e
	}
	rt := n.c.rt
	owner := scope.nodeFor(rt)
	if owner == nil || owner.kind != kindBox || owner.flags&flagSelectable == 0 {
		return e
	}
	valid := false
	for p, depth := n, 0; p != nil && depth < 64; p, depth = p.parent, depth+1 {
		if p == owner {
			valid = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !valid {
		return e
	}
	if len(rt.textMenuTargets) >= textMenuTargetLimit {
		rt.textMenuOverflow = true
		return e
	}
	rt.textMenuTargets = append(rt.textMenuTargets, textMenuTarget{owner.id, n.id, token})
	return e
}

func (rt *engine) resetTextMenuTargets() {
	clear(rt.textMenuTargets)
	rt.textMenuTargets = rt.textMenuTargets[:0]
	rt.textMenuOverflow = false
}
func (rt *engine) commitTextMenuTargets() {
	rt.textMenuFrames = nil
	if rt.textMenuOverflow || len(rt.textMenuTargets) == 0 {
		rt.resetTextMenuTargets()
		return
	}
	targets := make(map[uint64]textMenuTarget, len(rt.textMenuTargets))
	for _, t := range rt.textMenuTargets {
		if _, dup := targets[t.row]; dup {
			rt.resetTextMenuTargets()
			return
		}
		targets[t.row] = t
	}
	frames := make(map[uint64]*textMenuFrame)
	count := 0
	for _, s := range rt.texts {
		if s.seen != rt.frame || s.textScope == 0 || s.editor == nil || !s.editor.laidOut() || s.vw <= 0 || s.vh <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		scope := rt.states[s.textScope]
		if scope == nil || scope.seen != rt.frame || scope.vw <= 0 || scope.vh <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		var target textMenuTarget
		valid := false
		for p, depth := s, 0; p != nil && depth < 64; p, depth = rt.states[p.parent], depth+1 {
			if p.seen != rt.frame || p.flags&(flagDisabled|flagInvisible|flagInert) != 0 {
				break
			}
			if t, ok := targets[p.id]; ok && t.scope == s.textScope && target.token == nil {
				target = t
			}
			if p.id == scope.id {
				valid = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !valid || target.token == nil {
			continue
		}
		// Registered text-block geometry, not glyph-line nearest selection. Code
		// renderer chunk grouping and GPUI partial clipping are caller-visible limits.
		world := s.world
		if !finiteMenuNumber(world.A) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.B) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.C) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.D) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.X) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.Y) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.G) || !finiteMenuNumber(world.H) {
			continue
		}
		raw := transformRect(world, Rect{s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h})
		clip := Rect{s.vx, s.vy, s.vw, s.vh}
		if !finiteMenuRect(raw) || !finiteMenuRect(clip) || !finiteMenuRect(Rect{scope.vx, scope.vy, scope.vw, scope.vh}) {
			continue
		}
		box := intersect(raw, clip)
		if !finiteMenuRect(box) {
			continue
		}
		count++
		if count > textMenuBlockLimit {
			rt.resetTextMenuTargets()
			return
		}
		f := frames[scope.id]
		if f == nil {
			f = &textMenuFrame{scope: scope.id, frame: rt.frame, visible: Rect{scope.vx, scope.vy, scope.vw, scope.vh}}
			frames[scope.id] = f
		}
		f.blocks = append(f.blocks, textMenuBlock{s.id, box, target.token})
	}
	rt.textMenuFrames = frames
	rt.resetTextMenuTargets()
}
func (rt *engine) captureTextMenuTarget(s *state, x, y float32, button bool) {
	rt.textMenuOpening = nil
	if button || s == nil || rt.closed || !finiteMenuNumber(x) || !finiteMenuNumber(y) {
		return
	}
	f := rt.textMenuFrames[s.id]
	if f == nil || f.frame != rt.frame {
		return
	}
	rt.textMenuOpening = resolveTextMenuTarget(f, x, y, rt.hitChain)
}

// Resolve scans at most the bounded block set and performs at most ONE full
// hit-chain walk. An occluded closest block fails closed; no farther fallback.
func resolveTextMenuTarget(f *textMenuFrame, x, y float32, hitChain func(float32, float32) []uint64) *textMenuEvent {
	if f == nil || len(f.blocks) > textMenuBlockLimit || !finiteMenuNumber(x) || !finiteMenuNumber(y) || !finiteMenuRect(f.visible) || !f.visible.Contains(x, y) {
		return nil
	}
	best := float32(math.Inf(1))
	var candidate *textMenuBlock
	for i := range f.blocks {
		b := &f.blocks[i]
		r := b.bounds
		if !finiteMenuRect(r) {
			continue
		}
		d := max(r.X-x, x-r.X-r.W, 0) + max(r.Y-y, y-r.Y-r.H, 0)
		if !finiteMenuNumber(d) || d < 0 || d >= best {
			continue
		}
		best = d
		candidate = b
	}
	if candidate == nil || candidate.token == nil {
		return nil
	}
	r := candidate.bounds
	px := min(max(x, r.X), r.X+r.W-min(float32(.001), r.W/2))
	py := min(max(y, r.Y), r.Y+r.H-min(float32(.001), r.H/2))
	if !finiteMenuNumber(px) || !finiteMenuNumber(py) {
		return nil
	}
	for _, id := range hitChain(px, py) {
		if id == candidate.id {
			return &textMenuEvent{scope: f.scope, frame: f.frame, distance: best, token: candidate.token}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func finiteMenuRect(r Rect) bool {
	return finiteMenuNumber(r.X) && finiteMenuNumber(r.Y) && finiteMenuNumber(r.W) && finiteMenuNumber(r.H) && finiteMenuNumber(r.X+r.W) && finiteMenuNumber(r.Y+r.H) && r.W > 0 && r.H > 0
}
func finiteMenuNumber(v float32) bool { return !math.IsNaN(float64(v)) && !math.IsInf(float64(v), 0) }

// TextMenuHit returns an opaque registered target only while collecting this
// scope's pointer context menu. Uses the original event and committed geometry,
// never a later pointer position; strictly distance < maxGap. Negative, NaN or
// infinite limits fail closed. Keyboard/menu-button and chosen replay return no
// hit. Default unregistered menus are unaffected. No selection is changed.
func (m *Menu) TextMenuHit(scope Element, maxGap float32) (any, bool) {
	if m == nil || m.rt == nil || m.run == nil || !m.run.collect || m.rt.closed || !finiteMenuNumber(maxGap) || maxGap < 0 {
		return nil, false
	}
	n := scope.nodeFor(m.rt)
	hit := m.textHit
	if n == nil || hit == nil || hit.scope != n.id || hit.frame+1 != m.rt.frame || hit.token == nil || n.disabled() || n.flags&(flagInvisible|flagInert) != 0 {
		return nil, false
	}
	if !finiteMenuNumber(hit.distance) || hit.distance < 0 || hit.distance >= maxGap {
		return nil, false
	}
	return hit.token, true
}

// Collecting reports the existing menu opening phase, not chosen replay.
// It is a read-only observation and does not add or remove menu items.
func (m *Menu) Collecting() bool { return m != nil && m.run != nil && m.run.collect }
